name: PEG-30 Glyceryl cocoate
description: PEG-30 Glyceryl Cocoate (CAS 68201-46-7 ), also marketed as ethoxylated coco glycerides, is a mild, water-dispersible emulsifier and surfactant derived from coconut oil glycerides reacted with polyethylene glycol. It functions as a solubilizer, wetting agent, and humectant across personal care, cleaning, and textile applications. In rinse-off and leave-on cosmetic formulations, it solubilizes oils and fragrance components into aqueous systems. This ingredient is frequently used in shampoos, shower gels, and body lotions while contributing skin-conditioning properties. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations use it to improve wetting and emulsification of oily soils. It is particularly effective where mildness to substrates is required. Textile processing benefits from its surface-wetting performance during dyeing and finishing operations, where uniform fiber penetration directly affects product quality. PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate, a lower-ethoxylate counterpart, is often specified alongside for comparison. However, the PEG-30 grade offers stronger hydrophilicity and better cold-water dispersibility for complex formulations. PEG-30 Glyceryl Cocoate is typically supplied as a liquid or paste depending on temperature and formulation grade. Cosmetic-grade material is the standard commercial specification for this versatile chemical. The quality of the material is strictly aligned to personal care industry requirements.
